en.title: Harry Potter HBO Series Drops Hogwarts Staff Posters: Dumbledore, Snape, McGonagall Revealed
en.summary: HBO's upcoming Harry Potter series has unveiled new character posters, giving fans their first official look at the actors portraying key Hogwarts faculty. The images spotlight Dumbledore, McGonagall, Snape, and Hagrid, building anticipation for the faithful adaptation.
en.body:
The magic is brewing, and HBO is giving us more glimpses into its ambitious **Harry Potter** television series. Following the initial reveal of the main trio's posters, the network has now dropped a new set of character art spotlighting four of Hogwarts' most formidable and beloved faculty members: Headmaster **Albus Dumbledore**, Professor **Minerva McGonagall**, Professor **Severus Snape**, and groundskeeper **Rubeus Hagrid**. These posters offer our first official look at **John Lithgow** as Dumbledore, **Janet McTeer** as McGonagall, **Paapa Essiedu** as Snape, and **Nick Frost** as Hagrid. The images also tease iconic wizarding artifacts, including Dumbledore's Elder Wand and Hagrid's distinctive pink umbrella, hinting at the meticulous attention to detail in this faithful adaptation of J.K. Rowling's seven-book saga.

The **Harry Potter** TV series, slated for a Christmas Day 2026 release on HBO and HBO Max, promises to be a comprehensive retelling of the beloved stories. The first season will dive deep into the events of "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone," laying the groundwork for Harry's journey through the wizarding world. The casting of these pivotal adult characters is crucial, as their performances will anchor the magical education and emotional core of the series. The selections of **John Lithgow**, a veteran actor known for his versatile roles, **Janet McTeer**, an Oscar-nominated powerhouse, **Paapa Essiedu**, who garnered acclaim for "I May Destroy You," and **Nick Frost**, a comedic and dramatic talent, suggest a commitment to bringing depth and gravitas to these iconic roles.

## The Weight of Hogwarts Legacy
The unveiling of these faculty posters has, predictably, ignited fervent discussion across the Harry Potter fandom. For viewers who grew up with the books and films, these characters are more than just professors; they are mentors, antagonists, and pillars of the wizarding world. The choices made in casting and portrayal carry immense weight, with fans eager to see how these actors will embody the nuances of characters like the enigmatic Snape, the stern yet fair McGonagall, the wise Dumbledore, and the gentle giant Hagrid. Social media has already seen debate and excitement surrounding the new looks, particularly the visual representation of the Elder Wand and Hagrid's umbrella, which fans are scrutinizing for their fidelity to the source material. The stakes are high for HBO to deliver performances that resonate with established fan expectations while also bringing fresh interpretations to the screen.

## What's Next on the Horizon
With these key faculty members now visually represented, anticipation for further casting announcements and trailer releases will undoubtedly intensify. Fans will be watching closely for updates on the production timeline and any further hints at how the series plans to adapt the intricate plotlines and character developments that have captivated audiences for decades. The **Harry Potter** TV series is set to premiere on Christmas Day, 2026.

content_raw: After dropping character posters for the "Harry Potter" series highlighting the main trio, HBO has released a new batch featuring four major Hogwarts figures.
